issues.description: The problem statement (UML and textual description) specifies acceptSupplyDelivery should take four parameters (supplier name, ingredient name, price, quantity), but the provided example Main and the solution implementation define/expect a three-parameter signature (ingredient name, price, quantity). This mismatch makes it unclear whether students should implement a 3-parameter or 4-parameter method and may lead to compilation or test failures depending on which signature is used.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter list consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) Update the problem statement (UML and description) to declare acceptSupplyDelivery(String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) to match the example Main and solution; or (B) update the example Main and the solution to implement acceptSupplyDelivery(String supplierName, String ingredientName, int price, int quantity) (and handle/ignore the supplier parameter as appropriate). Ensure all references (UML, textual description, example calls, and solution/template) use the same signature.
